Macrons

Consonantal i

Body, health & movement

somersault noun and verb

also flip, acrobatic flip, do a somersault

modern

saltus cernuus; saltūs cernuī m.

somersault, acrobatic flip

Singular nominative and genitive. Morgan–Owens lists the plural saltūs cernuī; the singular is inflected here from that expression. These words distinguish turning an object over from a bodily flip; they do not imply that a coin toss, switch operation, cartwheel and airborne backflip all have the same exact technical name.

Examples

  • Saltum cernuum fac.

    Do a somersault.composed

Other words

  • cernuō, cernuāre — do a somersault

    verb, first conjugation · modern · M-O s.v. somersault (verb)

    Recorded by Morgan–Owens, including an Apuleius reference.

See also flip over, jump.
